title: Bertazzoni — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Bertazzoni.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "La Tradizione del Buon Gusto." Premium tier. Bertazzoni has been making cooking equipment in Guastalla, Italy since 1882 — six generations of the same family. Their ranges feature hand-finished brass burners, Italian design, and dual-fuel options that pair a gas cooktop with an electric convection oven. The Master and Heritage series bring authentic Italian craftsmanship at prices well below Wolf or Thermador.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Design-conscious buyers who want European character. Italian kitchen aesthetic. Luxury look at a more accessible price point.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Bertazzoni:

• Six generations of Italian craftsmanship since 1882 — not a startup, a legacy

• Hand-finished brass burners — beautiful and functional

• Dual-fuel models pair gas cooktop with electric convection oven — best of both worlds

• Italian design stands out in a sea of stainless American pro-style ranges

• Priced 30-40% below Wolf/Thermador with genuine European quality
